I have set up the harness and Chromium rendering tools, built and refined `/workspace/scene.js`, and verified both its physics reliability and visual presentation across camera angles.

### Summary of Design (`/workspace/scene.js`)
- **Shingled Multi-Stage Channel (`18` physical boxes total):**
  - **Reception Funnel & Upper Ramp:** A high backstop and tapered side walls around `[-0.85, 0.8, -0.3]` capture all drop offsets and initial velocities, smoothly narrowing the marble path toward the main axis without any inward lips.
  - **Shingled Floor & Wall Transitions:** Each subsequent ramp section steps slightly down in floor height and slightly outward in inner wall width in the direction of motion, preventing the marble from ever catching on a seam regardless of friction (`0.02–0.3`) or restitution (`0.05–0.45`).
  - **Full-Length Guard Roofs & Cup Lock Hood:** Protective top baffles cover the ramp sections and enclose the cup at `[0.8, 0, 0.3]` with an angled internal check-baffle so that sudden table bumps (`0.1–0.5 m/s` at any time `0.5–8.0 s`) cannot eject the marble from the run or out of the cup.
- **Polished Desk Toy Aesthetics (`add.decor`):** Added turned wooden trestle support towers with brass feet and cross-braces, brass arch straps, a felt-lined desk blotter, an articulated brass desk lamp, stacked hardcover books with a spare marble display tray, a ceramic coffee mug, and a potted succulent.
